In Northern Nigeria, near the border with Niger, there are dozens of men who make a living by putting on "live shows" with hyenas, monkeys, and snakes. I went all the way out there to expose these animal abusers and ask them the most important questions. I'd love to hear your take on this bizarre story in the comments down below.
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
